1.name: Fey Presence
1.description: Action projects a 10-ft cube charming or frightening creatures until end of your next turn (1/Short Rest).

6.name: Misty Escape
6.description: Reaction upon taking damage turns Invisible and teleports up to 60 ft (1/Short Rest).

10.name: Beguiling Defenses
10.description: Immunity to the Charmed condition and Reaction reflects Charm attempts back at the caster.

14.name: Dark Delirium
14.description: Action plunges a creature within 60 ft into a 1-minute illusory realm (Charmed/Frightened, 1/Short Rest).

1.name: Dark One's Blessing
1.description: When reducing a hostile creature to 0 HP, gain Temporary HP equal to CHA modifier + Warlock level.

6.name: Dark One's Own Luck
6.description: Add +1d10 to an ability check or saving throw after rolling (1/Short or Long Rest).

10.name: Fiendish Resilience
10.description: Choose one damage type after every Short or Long Rest to gain Resistance against it (except magical/silvered weapons).

14.name: Hurl Through Hell
14.description: On an attack hit, banish target through the lower planes for 10d10 Psychic damage (if not a Fiend, 1/Long Rest).

1.name: Awakened Mind
1.description: Telepathically speak to any creature you can see within 30 ft if it understands at least one language.

6.name: Entropic Ward
6.description: Reaction imposes Disadvantage on an attack against you; if it misses, gain Advantage on your next attack (1/Short Rest).

10.name: Thought Shield
10.description: Your thoughts cannot be read, and you gain Resistance to Psychic damage (reflecting Psychic back at attackers).

14.name: Create Thrall
14.description: Action charms an incapacitated humanoid indefinitely until removed with Remove Curse/Greater Restoration.

1.name: Bonus Cantrips & Healing Light
1.description: Learn Light and Sacred Flame; pool of (1 + Warlock level) d6s heals allies within 60 ft as a Bonus Action.

6.name: Radiant Soul
6.description: Gain Resistance to Radiant damage and add CHA modifier to one Radiant or Fire spell damage roll.

10.name: Celestial Resilience
10.description: Gain Warlock level + CHA Temporary HP after Short/Long Rests and grant half level + CHA Temporary HP to up to 5 allies.

14.name: Searing Vengeance
14.description: Instead of making a Death Save at start of turn, spring up with half HP, dealing 2d8 + CHA Radiant and blinding nearby foes (1/Long Rest).

1.name: Hexblade's Curse & Hex Warrior
1.description: Gain Medium Armor, Shields, and Martial Weapons; use CHA for weapon attacks/damage; Bonus Action curse adds +PB damage, 19–20 crits, and healing on kill.

6.name: Accursed Specter
6.description: Raise a slain humanoid's spirit as a loyal Specter until your next Long Rest (1/Long Rest).

10.name: Armor of Hexes
10.description: Reaction against cursed target's hit turns attacks of 4+ on d6 into misses.

14.name: Master of Hexes
14.description: Transfer Hexblade's Curse to another creature within 30 ft when the cursed creature dies.

hexblades_curse.name: Hexblade's Curse
hexblades_curse.hint: Bonus to damage rolls against the cursed target.

1.name: Tentacle of the Deeps & Gift of the Sea
1.description: Gain 40-ft Swim speed and water-breathing; Bonus Action summons a spectral Tentacle attacking for 1d8 Cold and slowing 10 ft (PB/Long Rest).

6.name: Oceanic Soul & Guardian Coil
6.description: Resistance to Cold damage and underwater telepathy; Tentacle reduces ally damage within 10 ft by 1d8 as a Reaction.

10.name: Grasping Tentacles
10.description: Learn Evard's Black Tentacles, cast it 1/Long Rest without a slot, and gain Warlock level Temporary HP.

14.name: Fathomless Plunge
14.description: Action teleports yourself and up to 5 creatures up to 1 mile through water (1/Short Rest).

tentacle_of_the_deeps.name: Tentacle of the Deeps
tentacle_of_the_deeps.hint: Bonus action melee spell attack, reduces target speed by 10ft.

1.name: Genie's Vessel
1.description: Choose Dao/Djinni/Efreeti/Marid; store items inside a pocket vessel (Bottled Respite) and add +PB elemental damage once per turn (Genie's Wrath).

6.name: Elemental Gift
6.description: Gain Resistance matching your Genie kind and Bonus Action 30-ft hover Fly Speed for 10 minutes (PB/Long Rest).

10.name: Sanctuary Vessel
10.description: Bring up to 5 allies into Bottled Respite where a 10-minute stay grants Short Rest benefits + extra Hit Die healing.

14.name: Limited Wish
14.description: Action duplicates any 6th-level or lower spell from any class with 1 Action casting time (1/1d4 Long Rests).

1.name: Form of Dread
1.description: Bonus Action grants 1d10 + Warlock level Temp HP, immunity to Frightened, and chance to Frighten on hit for 1 min (PB/Long Rest).

6.name: Grave Touched
6.description: No need to eat/drink/breathe; convert weapon/spell attack damage to Necrotic (+1 extra damage die while in Form of Dread).

10.name: Necrotic Husk
10.description: Resistance to Necrotic damage (Immunity in Form of Dread), and explode in 2d10 + Warlock level Necrotic instead of dropping to 0 HP (1/1d4 Long Rests).

14.name: Spirit Projection
14.description: Project an invisible/flying spirit from your body gaining BPS resistance and Conjuration/Necromancy healing (1/Long Rest).

1.name: Among the Dead
1.description: Learn Spare the Dying, Advantage on saves vs Disease, and Undead must pass a WIS save to target you.

6.name: Defy Death
6.description: Regain 1d8 + CON mod HP when succeeding on a Death Save or stabilizing an ally (1/Long Rest).

10.name: Undying Nature
10.description: Hold breath indefinitely, no need to eat/drink/sleep, and age at 1/10th normal rate.

14.name: Indestructible Life
14.description: Bonus Action regains 1d8 + Warlock level HP and reattaches severed body parts (1/Short Rest).
